usedFor: CTM tracks phone calls, and HubSpot logs the outcome after each “Call Ends” through “Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Call Ends” in CTM, then “Create Deal” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A finished call opens a deal while it is fresh, instead of waiting for someone to log it.

watchOut: “Update Contact” finds the contact by email, so a call without one cannot reach the right record.
